raw_text: UPDATE: Northeast India bandh coordination underway. Over 40 Telegram groups now sharing protest routes and barricade locations. Instructions being circulated for blocking National Highway 27 at multiple points. Student unions in Guwahati, Dibrugarh, and Jorhat have confirmed participation. Rail roko at all major stations from 6 AM.
